pool.text: Construction of a dam in the Rotte river.
Rotterdam granted city rights by Count William IV.
Establishment of the Rotterdam Chamber of the VOC.
Rotterdam, New York founded by Dutch settlers and named after Dutch city.
Netherlands abolished involvement in the slave trade.
Nieuw Rotterdam established in Suriname's Nickerie District.
Rotterdam boxer Bep van Klaveren wins Olympic gold in Amsterdam.
Swimmer Marie Braun wins gold medal at Amsterdam Olympics.
Opening of Feyenoord's De Kuip stadium.
Rie Mastenbroek, coached by Ma Braun, wins three Olympic golds in Berlin.
Daan Kagchelland wins Olympic gold in O‑Jolle sailing.
11,000 Jews still lived in Rotterdam.
Rotterdam, New York designated as a 'first class town'.
Piet Roozenburg becomes world draughts champion.
Lijnbaan opened, Europe's first car‑free shopping street.
Rotterdam became seat of Catholic bishop after diocese split.
Euromast erected for the Floriade exhibition.
First Floriade held in Het Park, Euromast built.
Rotterdam launches the Netherlands' first metro system.
Nedlloyd merged with P&O to form P&O Nedlloyd.
